intended_object: The number 3, encoded in the library's own computational unreduced-rational type `RawRat` (numerator/denominator pair), named so the machine-checked optimizer scale formulas can use it. Inferred from the docstring and the module name.
explanation: The body is `RawRat.ofNat 3`, i.e. `⟨3, 1, _⟩`, which does represent 3. It is a named literal in an internal raw-rational type built for computation, not a mathematical notion in its own right. It is an implementation detail of the library's verified-computation setup, so it has no counterpart in the literature to compare it with.
